message: Vector Rebel 3.2.52 candidate: continuous exact-identity verification for clipped PPE names in Tour and Daily Captain.
releaseNotes: Candidate on draft PR #18, not yet live accepted. Based on repeated Baldree reports affecting Bunker Coat, Structural Gloves, Hood and Structural Boot. A single bounded verification loop now waits for the exact Vector pool/item route, independently labeled matching serial, complete matching PPE title/type, and verified full name before proceeding. Unverified and wrong-owner gear still blocks without inspection. Both Tour and read-only Daily Captain use the same logic. Source-level regression tests must pass; live field acceptance and release approval remain required. Preserves previous 3.2.51 and 3.2.50 protections.
